title: Number of Binominal Coefficients
statementMd:
For a given prime integer $*p*$ and integers $α, *A*$ calculate the number of pairs of integers $(*n*, *k*)$, such that $0 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ *A*$ and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a4b0ae77c1b1e95e3cba7276cfb7fecdb99b4221.png) is divisible by $*p*^{α}$.

As the answer can be rather large, print the remainder of the answer moduly $10^{9} + 7$.

Let us remind you that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a4b0ae77c1b1e95e3cba7276cfb7fecdb99b4221.png) is the number of ways $*k*$ objects can be chosen from the set of $*n*$ objects.

## Input

The first line contains two integers, $*p*$ and $α$ ($1 ≤ *p*, α ≤ 10^{9}$, $*p*$ is prime).

The second line contains the decimal record of integer $*A*$ ($0 ≤ *A* < 10^{1000}$) without leading zeroes.

## Output

In the single line print the answer to the problem.

## Note

In the first sample three binominal coefficients divisible by 4 are ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a4c2b94fb12d1298dafcd1d14d7e1f6a47500264.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/80436d3bb1008bf8943b41f46211501e7fea05e9.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bb01b873c593007ca5b10a8897a71c4b0d7dabae.png).
statementZhMd:
对于给定的素数 $*p*$ 以及整数 $α$、$*A*$，求满足 $0 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ *A*$ 且

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a4b0ae77c1b1e95e3cba7276cfb7fecdb99b4221.png)

能被 $*p*^{α}$ 整除的整数对 $(*n*, *k*)$ 的数量。

由于答案可能很大，请输出答案模 $10^{9} + 7$ 的余数。

提醒一下，

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a4b0ae77c1b1e95e3cba7276cfb7fecdb99b4221.png)

表示从 $*n*$ 个物体中选出 $*k*$ 个物体的方法数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*p*$ 和 $α$（$1 ≤ *p*, α ≤ 10^{9}$，$*p*$ 为素数）。

第二行包含整数 $*A*$ 的十进制表示（$0 ≤ *A* < 10^{1000}$），且不含前导零。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出题目的答案。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，有三个能被 4 整除的二项式系数，它们是

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a4b0ae77c1b1e95e3cba7276cfb7fecdb99b4221.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/80436d3bb1008bf8943b41f46211501e7fea05e9.png) 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bb01b873c593007ca5b10a8897a71c4b0d7dabae.png)。
